senses.gloss:
[रय्-अच्] 
__1 The stream of a river, current; जम्बूकुञ्जप्रतिहतरयं तोयमादाय गच्छेः [[Me. 20.]] 
__2 Force, speed, velocity; तोयस्येवाप्रतिहतरयः सैकतं सेतुमोघः [[U. 3. 36]]; [[Bhāg. 5. 3. 14.]] 
__3 Zeal, ardour, vehemence, impetuosity.

A king, prince (often at the beginning or end of proper names; it is a corruption of राजन्). 
-Comp. 
-रङ्गालम् a kind of dance.

m., n. Ved. 
__1 Water. 
__2 Wealth; एष वै रयिरात्मा वैश्वानरः [[Ch. Up. 5. 16. 1.]] 
__3 Stuff, material, food; रयिं च प्राणं चेत्येतौ [[Praśna. Up. 1. 4.]]

__1 N. of Kubera. 
__2 Agni. 
__3 Brahman. 
-ष्ठम् N. of various Sāmans.
